en: The Philippine Senate has 24 members, while the House of Representatives has over 300 district and party-list members.
The Philippines celebrated its 125th Independence Day in 2023, exactly 125 years after declaring freedom in 1898.
The Philippines has over 180 distinct languages, but only Filipino and English are used as official national languages.
Jose Rizal wrote two famous novels, Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo, before his execution at age 35.
The MassKara Festival features over 400 street dancers wearing giant, smiling masks to boost Bacolod's morale in 1980.
The Banaue Rice Terraces, carved by the Igorot people over 2,000 years ago, sit 1,000 meters above sea level.
Filipino marine scientist Angel Alcala discovered 50 new species of reptiles and amphibians during his 60-year scientific career.
The Philippine Eagle, the national bird, stands about 1 meter tall and has a 2-meter wingspan.
The 1987 Philippine Constitution contains 18 Articles and was ratified by 76 percent of voters during a national plebiscite.
National Artist Guillermo Tolentino sculpted the 12.7-meter Bonifacio Monument, which stands much taller than a standard four-story building.
The Philippines comprises 7,641 islands, but only about 2,000 of these islands are permanently inhabited by people.
The Philippine flag features 8 rays on its sun, representing the first 8 provinces that revolted against Spain.
